name: Robalzotan
summary: Robalzotan is a selective serotonin 5-HT1A receptor antagonist which was under development for the treatment of major depressive disorder, anxiety disorders, gastrointestinal disorders, irritable bowel syndrome (IBS), and overactive bladder but was never marketed.

pharmacology.text: Robalzotan (INN, BAN; developmental code names NAD-299 and AZD-7371) is a selective serotonin 5-HT1A receptor antagonist which was under development for the treatment of major depressive disorder, anxiety disorders, gastrointestinal disorders, irritable bowel syndrome (IBS), and overactive bladder but was never marketed.
